up: Retrieve exact IC50 values in nM for compounds tested against human Mitogen-activated protein kinase 14. Required output columns: molecule ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID, DOI, assay description, target preferred name, target organism, and exact IC50 value in nM. Apply filters: target preferred name equals 'Mitogen-activated protein kinase 14', target organism equals 'Homo sapiens', activity standard type equals 'IC50', standard relation equals '=', and standard units equal 'nM'. Join tables: activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, and docs. Do not apply any ranking or row limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_preferred_name, td.organism AS target_organism, a.standard_value AS exact_ic50_nm FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.pref_name = 'Mitogen-activated protein kinase 14' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
